intent: This public backlog intentionally excludes deployment-specific observations, direct user evidence, account details, and personal taste. Product-wide laws and repair classes live in contracts.jsonl and failure-modes.jsonl; future backlog entries must be independently useful to every deployment.

Integrate the phone notification stream as a locally curated attention surface with visible reversible controls, private lock-screen defaults, deterministic light processing, and fail-safe preservation of Android-owned urgent and safety behavior.

Maintain two honest installation channels around the same signed phone product: resumable manual setup with a local coding agent for technical users, and a supported managed provisioning path for nontechnical fleets. Platform security prompts and enrollment remain visible boundaries, not obstacles to bypass.
